title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Golf Saudi Women’s Shift
items.text: Golf Saudi announced a multiyear commitment to women's golf with a $4 million event next week in Britain, co-sanctioned by LPGA and LET, but dropped most other PIF-backed events including the Aramco Championship from the LPGA schedule.

items.headline: Presidents Cup Raises Ryder Cup Concerns
items.text: Despite Team USA's comeback win at the Presidents Cup, poor foursomes performance signals major issues ahead of the 2027 Ryder Cup.
